policy: The exact inputs that shipped art packs rest on, each with the rights it is used under. A pack may rest only on an input recorded here; web/tools/sourcelicensegate.mjs refuses a release whose shipped packs rest on an input without recorded rights. licenseStatus records the owner's declaration; rights.components keeps every part's own origin, including parts taken from another input; rights.review records whether a person has evidenced and reviewed that declaration (NOT_REQUIRED only for the studio's own work with its evidence). Evidence is named by reference; the documents stay private.

inputs.scope: basis of the civilian role packs (c1-c11, chan, delphi, einstein, tecn, tecn2) and the rifle study

rights.made: the CGTrader model, built by its author on Reallusion Character Creator base parts (its CC_Base_* names show it); the studio remodelled it in Blender
rights.evidence: EV-DL-20260908-CGT-4945005: the download record of the supplied file (source URL and date) on the owner's machine; its sha256 is the one above

review.note: the owner confirmed on 2026-09-26 that the CGTrader download history lists this model under the Royalty Free licence; the game ships it only inside its own .ssmesh/.sspbr packs

rights.terms: CGTrader Royalty Free License: use in own projects and commercial use allowed; a game may carry it inside a proprietary format (21A.2), with reasonable measures against end users extracting it (21A.3); no redistribution of the file as downloaded.
